strategy: Pinned GNU shell program interpreted by the linked C2Rust Bash entry; frcode is separately C2Rust translated. Private command symlinks invoke this executable. Explicit user command-directory and shell overrides retain GNU semantics.
limitations: Default database parent /var/lib/rboxc must already exist; no privileged installation is implicit.
Native user-switch helper su remains external; user-switch and network filesystem profiles are not certified.
GNU shell script logic is retained, not claimed as C2Rust-generated Rust.
